verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document bulk operations, such as bulk user import, mass group assignment or batch updates. The SCIM docs describe CRUD on user and group resources without any bulk or batch capability. The MCP server examples are single-item actions (create one user) or read-only listing queries, not bulk operations on many items. Bulk operations are a fair axis for an identity platform, so absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
